items.prompt: Why prefer unique_ptr to shared_ptr when only one owner is required?

options.text: shared_ptr makes every dangling observer impossible
options.why: Raw observers can still outlive the last shared owner.

options.text: unique_ptr must be manually deleted on each return path
It expresses the intended single-owner lifetime policy
options.why: Shared ownership adds a different contract and cost.

options.text: All dynamic allocation is faster than scoped values
options.why: Allocation should be avoided when it is unnecessary.

items.explanation: Choose the ownership semantics needed by the interface, not a broad assumption that more sharing is safer.
